The pens are 14K and 10K gold-filled as marked on the barrels, with weights of 16.9 grams for the 14K gold-filled pen and 36.7 grams for the 10K gold-filled two-pen set. Each pen has a slim design with a gold tone finish, black plastic end caps, and the Cross pocket clip. The pens are in very good condition with minimal wear and original Cross stickers on the clips. Cross is a well-known brand established in 1846, recognized for quality writing instruments.

275326785.description:
Mixed Natural Mineral and Rock Specimens Lot Quartz Calcite Chert Flint
This lot contains unpolished natural mineral and rock specimens suitable for collectors, educational use, or lapidary projects. Included are a large white quartz crystal, multiple pieces of brownish chert or flint, a yellow calcite crystal, and assorted tumbled and rough stones of various sizes and colors. The specimens are in raw, unprocessed condition with natural fractures and rough edges visible. The rocks range from small pebbles to larger hand-sized pieces. The lot is contained in a clear plastic container for easy sorting and examination. No brand or model is associated.

Description:
Discover a unique assortment with this mixed gemstone lot, perfect for collectors, jewelry makers, or enthusiasts exploring natural minerals. This selection includes five distinct pieces: a finely polished agate slice showcasing intricate banding and rich, earthy hues; a rectangular amber piece featuring an organic inclusion; a clear quartz crystal point with natural terminations; a rough reddish-brown tourmaline cluster exhibiting raw crystal structure; and a deep garnet cluster with naturally formed surfaces. Each stone brings its own visual appeal and tactile qualities, whether you're interested in display, crafting, or study. The agate slice is ideal for decorative settings, the amber is prized by fossil and crystal lovers, while tourmaline, quartz, and garnet are versatile for lapidary or educational use. Condition ranges from polished to raw, highlighting the beauty of each gem's origin. Purchase confidently knowing each stone is naturally sourced and untreated, making this lot a diverse addition for any gemstone aficionado.
